goal: Repair goal fidelity, executable interface contracts, checkpoint eligibility, and owner-based post-build repair before resuming the formal CS2 candidate.
acceptance_criteria: An explicit CLI-plus-JSON/HTML-report analysis goal preserves its named product, acquisition, parser, evidence, safety, reporting, and test capabilities instead of becoming a generic workbench or gaining an unrequested GUI/frontend.

Leaf publication validation uses file-kind-specific contracts: Python import names, JavaScript exports, HTML ids, CSS custom properties, and documentation anchors are never treated as interchangeable symbols.

Generated stage, orchestrator, artifact, report, and test leaves share one executable interface contract; a contradictory result shape, constructor, method, or schema is rejected before a component checkpoint can pass.

A reused component checkpoint must still satisfy current required paths, declared runtime dependencies, goal capabilities, and its implemented upstream/downstream interface projection; historical PASS alone is insufficient.

Post-build failure planning selects implementation owners from traceback imports/calls and assertion evidence, keeps exact tests as dependent targets, and submits one atomic bounded repair set instead of defaulting to the first test files.

All changed Provider, post-build, project-management, and kernel-contract regression tests pass, and a bounded formal CS2 generation/resume probe records honest non-PASS if provider or generated runtime evidence remains incomplete.
The reviewed API/provider route and local_packager-only delivery exit remain unchanged.

quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.target: offline synthetic end-to-end workflow and generated-project tests pass, reports include signal-level evidence, confidence, limitations, and no unsupported accusation
quality_metrics.method: generated pytest suite, CLI runtime probe, artifact inspection, and source-adapter contract checks

quality_metrics.measure: bounded autonomous input discovery, fitness selection, retry, and truthful fallback
quality_metrics.target: the highest-fitness usable authorized candidate completes analysis and media generation; injected candidate failure selects the next candidate; synthetic fallback is opt-in and always PASS_WITH_LIMITS
quality_metrics.method: candidate-scoring unit tests, bounded-discovery security tests, retry integration tests, real auto-test CLI execution, report inspection, and package inspection

quality_metrics.measure: genuine public CS2 demo discovery, provenance verification, safe acquisition, and parser proof
quality_metrics.target: one dynamically discovered public CS2 demo has verified HTTPS provenance and archive hash, safely extracts, produces non-zero real ticks and player states through demoparser2, and completes the existing analysis workflow without synthetic classification
quality_metrics.method: catalog contract tests, archive security tests, live catalog discovery, real download hash verification, demoparser2 integration, runtime artifact inspection, and canonical package inspection

quality_metrics.measure: canonical goal behaviors mapped to substantive executable tests and a real passing post-build test run
quality_metrics.target: every canonical test intent has one exact non-trivial test symbol and the post-build goal-acceptance receipt is PASS before review readiness
quality_metrics.method: deterministic plan-identity inspection, Python test AST inspection, post-build test-result binding, and negative missing/trivial/failed-test cases

quality_metrics.measure: goal fidelity, typed publication contracts, executable cross-component interfaces, and eligible checkpoint reuse
quality_metrics.target: all injected goal-drift, file-kind, interface-shape, dependency, capability, and stale-checkpoint defects are rejected before final pytest
quality_metrics.method: deterministic GoalSpec/project-plan tests, leaf and merged-component contract tests, checkpoint negative cases, and formal CS2 fixture regression

prevention: Freeze measurable goal, scope, file-kind publication, executable interface, checkpoint, and repair-owner contracts before implementation.
Use EXP-CGKN-QUALITY-001 to keep planning, component validation, runtime evidence, and delivery truth independent.
Use EXP-CGKN-LIBRARIAN-001 to retain only direct implemented dependencies and affected repair owners in Provider context.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run focused GoalSpec, component-boundary, checkpoint, and post-build owner-selection tests after each increment.
Run project-management validation and targeted kernel/provider regressions.
Run a bounded formal CS2 generation or resume probe without promoting incomplete evidence.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: GoalSpec is the single product-scope authority and distinguishes user interaction modes from report artifact formats.
The generated pipeline uses one machine-readable stage result, artifact record, analysis result, and report input contract across implementation and tests.
Component checkpoints bind current requirements and implemented interface truth; same-run identity does not waive capability or dependency validation.
Post-build repair remains inside the existing Provider route, validates every leaf independently, and writes only a complete atomic repair set.
local_packager remains the only delivery exit.

feedback: CGKN mainline increment accepted; the formal generated candidate remains NEEDS_REWORK and PB-018 is not complete.

worked: Actual candidate failures were converted into deterministic goal, interface, fixture, checkpoint, semantic-review, and pytest-environment contracts.
did_not_work: Bounded semantic excerpts and global pytest plugin autoload initially obscured the generated project's real failures.
experiments: Revalidated the saved tests component under the current component gate; six deterministic blockers were found without another Provider call.
